messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to bump to v2.16 tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need changelog finalized, merge gates locked, and region rollout timings for US / EU / APAC. Can owners confirm availability and any constraints?

maria: On it. I can finish the changelog this morning. @jamal can you check the DB migration window for EU? Also what's the preferred merge-freeze cutoff?

jamal: EU DB team prefers 09:00 UTC for migrations (low traffic). For safety I'd like a merge freeze at 07:30 UTC so canaries get ~30m. No hard objections from infra?

sara: QA notes: we need an extra hour for regression runs on Dedicated infra. Would it be possible to freeze earlier, like 06:45 UTC, so we still have ~1.25h before the bump to validate? :thinking_face:

alex: I want to keep the bump at 08:00 UTC. Freezing earlier is ok if it buys QA time. Action items: @maria update changelog, @jamal confirm migration + prepare rollback, @sara schedule reg tests. @ci-bot can you apply a temporary branch-protection rule to block merges after the freeze?

ci-bot: auto: branch-protection-rule-added v2.16-freeze (ruleset id 12345). Rule active from 1925550300 until 1925553600. Details: https://ci.internal/rules/12345

maria: Changelog PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/458 — added migration notes and APAC hotfix section. @alex PTAL.

alex: LGTM, one tiny wording tweak for the migration note — pushed to the PR branch.

jamal: DB team confirmed for 09:00 UTC EU. I'll be on-call for the migration and will publish a rollback plan.

jamal: Rollback plan gist published: https://gist.github.com/jamal/rollback-v2.16 — includes steps, expected timings, and quick checks.

sara: QE scheduled regression window 06:00-07:00 UTC and invited the team. I'll verify both default config and the APAC-hotfix flag flow.

maria: @sara noted — changelog now mentions the APAC flag explicitly. Please validate that path.

alex: Final checklist for clarity: changelog PR merged by 07:00 UTC; branch protection enabled at 07:30 UTC; bump to v2.16 at 08:00 UTC (hosted); EU DB migration at 09:00 UTC; APAC warm deploy at 08:30 UTC. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you agree.

sara: :white_check_mark:

maria: :white_check_mark:

jamal: :white_check_mark: I'll post a short post-deploy checklist in this thread before bump.

ci-bot: deploy-scheduler: rollout job scheduled for v2.16 @ 1925553600 (08:00 UTC). Logs/trace: https://ci.internal/rollouts/8901

alex: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a brief runbook and handover notes in the next hour.

(incident-bot note: no incidents expected; standard rollback window 00:30 after bump)
